title: How a Godly Man Acts When No One Would Ever Know
caption:
A godly man's realest test isn't Sunday. It's the tab he'd close if you walked in. Who he is alone is who he is.

The hidden version, the one nobody's grading, is the actual you. Integrity just means the pieces match: the gym guy, the church guy, and the guy alone at midnight all have to be the same guy. What you'd hide is what's growing, because secrecy isn't neutral.

Confession is how the split closes. Telling one man the truth is the fastest way back to being whole.

#faith #integrity #accountability #godlyman #christianmen
